contract.name: casepath_observable_claim
contract.rule: Pass this object—and only this object—to downstream inference.

customer_message.body:
Dear Sir or Madam

As I understand it: The heating has been barely warm for three nights; On the phone I was only told that the part is on order; The living-room thermometer shows 15 to 17 degrees but is not calibrated, and the portable units barely cover the night; I cannot safely say more.

Regarding “repeated boiler failure during freezing weather in a vulnerable household”, for today's submission: the calibrated indoor temperature remains unresolved; for the request “secure emergency heating, a service report and a firm repair plan, and review the safeguards for an official deposit”: I have included everything currently available to me; on “repeated boiler failure during freezing weather in a vulnerable household”, I need a concise assessment first; also unresolved: the replacement part delivery; that is what I know today.

This leaves me requesting: secure emergency heating, a service report and a firm repair plan, and review the safeguards for an official deposit; in particular, I need clarity about the replacement part delivery and whether the records support an initial assessment.

I cannot confirm the exact date when this first started.

Thank you for clarifying; What matters most is the calibrated indoor temperature; I do not want to act before this is clear.

Kind regards
customer_message.subject: Request for review: repeated boiler failure during freezing weather in a vulnerable household
